followup_reviews.Researcher: GPT-6 Astra Pro /root (baseline half) and /root/verification_recovery (programme-addition half); prior involvement disclosed
followup_reviews.Separate challenger: GPT-6 Astra Pro /root/verification_recovery challenges baseline; /root challenges programme additions; separate same-model contexts with prior involvement disclosed
followup_reviews.Research finding: Retain the included ordinary-passenger restriction, with goods and emergency passages excepted. Contemporary reopening reporting supports the recorded scoped episode. The parent concerns the Algeria–Tunisia land frontier, both-way ordinary passengers/private cars. Nine posts are reported; AFP and Algerian Radio supply separate named-post observation, not an individual census of all posts. Retain 17 March 2020–15 July 2022, 850 calendar days, with qualified continuity and scope. AFP supplies retrospective exact onset; local resumption is observed. Calendar dates do not establish exact elapsed hours. Health and biosecurity / Human disease control is the reported pandemic purpose. No additional rationale is inferred from travel decline or reopening diplomacy. AFP reporting and Algerian Radio ministerial/local accounts were directly inspected. The minister’s 75-percent passenger reduction is consistent with exceptions, and rules out a zero-movement interpretation. The scoped phase remains unlocated. Named-post reporting does not itself approve a coordinate or whole-frontier operational geometry. Separate challenge: the goods-continuation statement is supported by a reported presidential account in Anadolu, rather than the inspected AFP passage. A June freight report describes border transshipment and later through-truck permission; no unrestricted or uniform freight-vehicle operation is inferred.
followup_reviews.Challenge verdict: Accepted within the root decision; see frozen challenge

This is a completed audit procedure for the sample, not proof every attribute or every record in the register is verified.

release_review.adjudication: Accept the fixed sixteen-parent audit, covering all21currentphases and96claimdomains. Apply seven guarded baseline cell refinements: cancellation/nonimplementation wording forSUP-004, local-resident reopening scope for quarantinedR3-SC-004, and correlated schedule alternatives forSUP-002 so a false0–2day range is not calculated. Retain both quarantine decisions and all existing source/date/continuity/geographic limits. Accept the baseline challenger’s source-language, goods-attribution and Greek article-number refinements plus the additional limited source readings. The eight new parents require no further factual changes: preserve their cohort, policy/schedule, day-level, unknown-endpoint and location qualifications. This is a completed audit procedure for the sample, not proof every attribute or every record in the register is verified.
